# archestra_virtual_key (Resource)

Revocable virtual LLM key with explicit provider routing, billing and spend cap. The sensitive value is saved on creation and recovered on import or refresh when the caller authored the key. Change rotation_nonce to replace and revoke the key. Passthrough keys carry no provider credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_virtual_key" "example" {
  name = "model-router"
  provider_api_keys = [{
    provider            = "openai"
    provider_api_key_id = archestra_model_provider.example.id
  }]
  spend_cap = { limit_value = 100, cleanup_interval = "calendar_month" }
  # Changing this value replaces the key and revokes its previous credential.
  rotation_nonce = "1"

  lifecycle {
    # Keeps a valid key available during rotation_nonce rotation.
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key display name.

### Optional

- `billing_team_id` (String) Team billed for this key; removing the value clears team billing.
- `expires_at` (String) Absolute RFC 3339 expiry; omission removes expiry.
- `include_future_providers` (Boolean) Use current and future shared primary provider keys, with explicit mappings as overrides.
- `key_type` (String) Immutable standard or passthrough key type.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Credential labels; an empty set clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `owner_id` (String) Creation-only owner selector, defaulting to the creator.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `provider_api_keys` (Attributes Set) Explicit provider-to-key mappings; an empty set clears explicit mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_api_keys))
- `rotation_nonce` (String) Change this value to replace the key and revoke its old credential; a first value set after import is recorded without rotation.
- `spend_cap` (Attributes) Credential-wide spend cap; removing it clears the cap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spend_cap))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Virtual key UUID.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Bearer credential returned on creation or revealed to its creator on import and refresh, retained in sensitive state; service-account creators need API 1.5.0-rc.1 or later.

### Nested Schema for `spend_cap`

Required:

- `limit_value` (Number) Positive dollar limit per window.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_virtual_key.example <id>
```
